versions.changelog: Ownership migrated to the trustgrowth org; content unchanged from 1.0.0

Initial release of backlink-opportunities.

- Analyzes backlink profiles to identify link-building opportunities, focusing on reclamation, competitor intersection, linkable assets, and unlinked mentions.
- Supports evidence from multiple providers (e.g., GSC, Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO), with strict handling of data sources and their limitations.
- Generates a prospect table and action plan; all outreach and any disavow actions remain strictly manual.
- Never automates outreach, proposes link schemes, or generates disavow files; adheres to strict ethical and Google-compliance boundaries.
- Detailed documentation included on supported use-cases, provider selection, and connectivity with related skills.
